_note: Owner-approved compartment + seat-size corrections for the AutoCount cutover, 2026-08-10. Every entry names the DOCUMENTS it applies to (SO and the PO raised from it are corrected together so they stay aligned), the MODEL, the target piece list left-to-right, and where known the seat depth in inches and the colour string as written on the source. `why` records how the answer was reached, because a year from now the reason matters more than the value.
_rules: Money never moves: the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0, exactly as the importer wrote it. Lines are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place wherever the code already exists, so an id - and any PO allocation hanging off it - survives. A document can hold MORE THAN ONE sofa build, so every entry carries desc2Match: only the lines whose description2 contains it are touched. Without that the script treats a second, perfectly good build as surplus and tries to delete it (caught on HC-SO-011957, which holds a 1R+1NA+1R sofa AND a Stool).
